changes.title: N.Y. enacts nation's first statewide moratorium on building new data centers
changes.summary: Building new data centers in New York will be paused for a year in order to allow state officials to establish guidelines protecting residents and the environment, Gov. Kathy Hochul said.

changes.title: Gov. Hochul orders a pause on data centers in New York for up to a year
changes.summary: Gov. Kathy Hochul signed an order pausing construction of large data centers — the first statewide pause in the country.

changes.title: 'Gus' the T. rex fetches record $50.1 mn at US auction
changes.summary: A Tyrannosaurus rex skeleton nicknamed "Gus" sold Tuesday for $50.1 million at Sotheby's in New York, making it the most valuable dinosaur fossil bought at auction after a 10-minute battle between seven bidders.
